latent_bug_repair_disclosed.bug: The kind filter in services/content/retrieval.ts rode a ${filter} tagged-template slot. A ${} slot BINDS — every kind-filtered content search (GET /api/v1/content/documents/search?kind=…, parsed at routes/content/index.ts:183-188) rendered $n between the scope EXISTS and the ORDER BY: a guaranteed Postgres syntax error -> 500. Same defect shape found and fixed in the new seam's step-1 before it ever served.

vercel_note: The serving flip runs on the api's existing driver dispatch (createSql): each warehouse = ONE extra env var (the URL) + one lazily-built client; Vercel/any host handles N databases as N env vars + N pooler endpoints — no platform obstacle. Neon pooler endpoints are the serverless-safe connection path (already the house law). Region note of record: W1 sits in ap-southeast-1 while main is us-east-2; the two-step seam pays one cross-region RTT per step (measured 105 ms + 430 ms from this sandbox). Function-region placement (or future warehouse region consolidation) is the operator's lever to halve seam latency; correctness is unaffected.
